email.subject: Two quick things on Shoreline Dentistry's site
email.body:
Hi Priya,

I checked Shoreline Dentistry's website and noticed it doesn't list your office hours anywhere. Patients searching for a dentist in Harbor Falls when they're in pain usually move to the next listing if they can't quickly confirm you're open - that's likely costing you new patient calls.

The footer also still shows outdated info, which makes the site feel unmaintained and can hurt trust for anyone comparing providers.

Both are quick fixes. I run Northlight Web, a one-person shop that fixes this kind of thing for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change?

Alex
